title: Unnamed president and wife see a ship while fishing on the coast
place_text: Coast of an unnamed large country (G7 member)

tellings.quote: The president and his wife, the first lady, were on vacation on the coast fishing, and this ship was descending there.

plain: The president of a large country, one of the G7 group of rich nations, was on a fishing holiday on the coast with his wife when they watched a ship come down from the sky. That is what a man named Kiran Ilum Xenov, who tells Michels he was himself taken by aliens in 1997, says the president told him, though he names neither the president, the country nor the year. If true, a sitting head of state would have seen such a craft with his own eyes.
